content: Imotata Gishshas Wodhdhida Woga
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Isra7eele asaas, ‹Ay asikka GODAAS as immanaas adinettiin he adinay polettiko he immana gi adinettidayssa wozzanaas adina wogay,
hessaade layththay nam7u tammaafe biidi usuppun tammu kumida attuma as gidikko GODAA Keeththan erettida meezaanen meezaanettidi ichchash tammu gidiza saqile
bira qanxxo.
Macca gidikko heedzdzu tammu saqile bira gido;
qasseka ichchash layththafe biidi nam7u tammu layth gakkanaas diza attuma naa gidikko nam7u tammu saqile bira, macca naa gidikko tammu saqile bira qanxxo;
issi aginappe biidi ichchash layth gakkanaas diza attuma naa gidikko ichchash saqile bira qanxxo; he layththata giddon diza macca naas gidikko heedzdzu saqile bira qanxxo.
Hessaththoka layththay usuppun tammaafe bollara diza attuma as gidikko tammanne ichchash saqile bira, macca gidikko tammu saqile bira qanxxo.

Adina adinettidaadey hayssa ha heregettoyssa qanxxanaas dandayontta keehi manqo gidikko izi ba immana gi adinidayssa qeeseza sinth ekki yo; qeesezikka adinettidaade xeelli be7idi izaade wolqqa keena herego.
« ‹Adina adinettidayssi Xoossas yarshanaas bessiza mehe gidikko hessa mala mehey Xoossas dumma gidida gishshas wozzettenna.
Adina adinettidaadey ba adinettida meheza hara mehen laammofo; gido attiin iitazakka lo7o mehen laammizaa gidikko izi kase ehoyssara nam7ayka Xoossas dummatidayta gidetto.
Izaadey immizayssi Xoossas yarshettanaas bessontta mehe gidikko he meheza ehidaadey meheza qeesekko eho.
Qeesezi he meheza iitateththinne iza lo7eteth caddi xeellidi izi kessana waaga yooto; he izi gida waagay izi gida mala hano.
He meheza goday meheza zaari miishshara shammana koykko he meheza waaga bolla xeetappe nam7u tammu kushe gujjidi shammo.
« ‹Issaadey ba keeth GODAAS dumma imota immiko qeeseta halaqay keeththay iitakkonne lo7okko iza hanoteth caddi xeelli heregidi waaga yooto; he qeesezi heregida waagay keeththaas herega gido.
Kase keeththaa goday he keeththaa zaari wozzana koykko heregettida waaga xeetappe nam7u tammu kushe bollara gujjidi keeththaa baas ekko.
« ‹Issaadey ba gadeppe shaakki GODAAS dumma imota immiko biittay immiza kaththaa mala heregetto; hessika issi kilo bangga gishshas ichchash tammu saqile biray qanxxetto.
Gadeza goday kase gadeza immiday wozzo layththa ba7aaleppe guye gidikko gades kase wodhdhida wogay laamettenna.
Izaadey gadaa immiday ichchash tammanththo layththaafe guye gidikko qeesezi hereganay yiza ichchash tammanththo layth gakkanaas diza attida layththaa qoodidi herego; miishshaafe ashshi ciggo.
Gadeza immidaadey zaari wozzana koykko kase gadezi heregettida waaga bolla xeetappe nam7u kushe gujjidi zaari wozzo.
Kase gadey ba gadaa Xoossafe miishshan wozzanaappe sinththan hara asas bayzidaa gidikko qasse he gadeza nam7anththo zaari wozzana wogay izas deenna.
Wozzo layththan gadey simmiza wode he gadezi gidikko GODAAS dummatidi qeeseta laata gade gidi atto.
« ‹Issaadey hara asappe shammi ekkida gade Xoossas immana koykko,
kaalli yiza wozzo layth gakkanaas gadezi kessana waaga qeesezi herego; he gallas he heregettida miish gadaadey qanxxo; he miishshayka Xoossa oosos dummatidaaz gidana.
Wozzo layththa ba7aaley gakkiza wode he gadeza koyro laatan ekkidi bayzidaades gadezi simmo.
He heregaza waagay GODAA Keeththan erettida meezaanen meezaanettidi nam7u tammu saqile gido.
« ‹Koyro bayra yelettida mehey izi kasekka GODAAS gidida gishshas oonikka iza Xoossas mela kiyateth immanaas dandayenna; galo mar gidiin woykko dorsanne deysha laaqqati kasetidi Xoossas dummatidayta.

Iza bolla wosoy diza mehenne yarsho shiishshanaas bessontta mehe gidikko he meheza goday iza heregettida waagaa bolla xeetaappe nam7u tammu kushe gujjidi zaari wozzi ekkanaas dandayees; iza goday wozzi ekkanaas koyontta ixxiko he heregettida waagaan hara asas bayzetto.
« ‹Issaadey ba godaas baas dizayssafe as gidiin woykko mehe, gidiin woykko gade gidiin kumeththara dumma shaakkidaappe guye mulekka bayzanaassinne zaari wozzanaas bessenna.
« ‹Asa giddofe shaakettidi deyana mala pirdettidaadey wozzettofo; izaadey hayqqanaas bessees.
« ‹Biittafe mokkiza kath gidiin woykko miththa ayfe gidiin tammaafe issoy Xoossas dummatida asraata.
Hessafe awayssaka baas wozzi ekkanaas koyzaadey he miishshay bayzettiza waagaas xeetappe nam7u tammu kushe gujjidi shammanaas dandayees.
Soo mehetappe tammaafe issay Xoossa gisha; mehey taybettishin tammanththay tammanththay GODAAS dumma shaakettidaaza.

Tammanththa mehey iita gidiin woykko lo7o gidiin dooroppo; woykko harara laammofo; laammizaa gidikko koyroyssinne laame imettidayssara nam7ayka GODAAS dummatidaaz gideettes attiin zaari wozzanaas dandayenna› ga yoota.»
Siina zumaa bolla GODAY Muse baggara Isra7eele asaa azazida azazoti haytantta.
